method_note: FAST MODE. Platform facts from each platform's own official pages only, read live 26 Nov 2026. Prices verbatim in original currency. Brand facts from live weddedwonderland.com only.

facts.claim: Paperless Post pay-per-event pricing uses Coins: multiply the design's Coin cost by the number of recipients. Paperless Post Plus (200 Coins) unlocks extra customisation and guest management tools. Sample calculator shows 3 Coins = $1.44 (USD).
facts.quote: Choose our flexible pay per event plan, where you can add design elements and management features a la carte. Multiply your invitation's Coin cost by the number of recipients for your total send cost. ... Paperless Post Plus 200 coins Unlock more of our customization and guest management tools when you add any Plus feature during the creation process. Great for professional events, weddings, and more. ... Total Coins to send 3 Coins $1.44
facts.use_note: USD (US$ implied; page shows $ with no currency label; US company). Page also carries a time-limited promo (20% off Coins, code ends 12/1); do not quote the promo.

facts.claim: Paperless Post says it also has many free designs; a Paperless Pro subscription is priced by annual guest count, shown at $250/year for 250 annual guests (USD).
facts.quote: Paperless Post also has many free invitations and greeting card designs for you to customize and send. ... Try the Paperless Pro subscription, which includes unlimited access to all our features and simple, transparent pricing (no Coins). Plans are based on annual guest count ... Annual guests 250 ... $250/year
facts.use_note: Subscription is pitched at professionals and 3+ events a year; not the obvious pick for one wedding.

facts.claim: Greenvelope sends digital invitations and cards with an animated envelope, liner, stamp and music, by email or text (in supported countries), with built-in RSVP tracking and guest list management; guests need no account; flat one-time price by guest count from $19 (USD), no subscription; ad-free.
facts.quote: Greenvelope digital invitations arrive with a signature animated envelope opening, a personalized liner, a stamp, and background music that sets the tone before guests read a word. Upload your own design or customize a designer suite, then send by email or text message (in supported countries) with built-in RSVP tracking and guest list management. Guests never need an account to reply. Pricing is a flat one-time amount set by guest count, starting at $19, with no subscription required.
facts.use_note: Currency shown as $ with no label; treat as USD. Text delivery is 'in supported countries': whether Australia is supported is unclear.

facts.claim: Canva plans: Free US$0/month for one person; Pro US$18/month for one person (page shows a time-limited 50% off first 3 months). Prices exclude applicable tax.
facts.quote: Free ... US$0 /month for one person ... Pro ... US$18 ... /month for one person ... Prices exclude applicable tax.
facts.use_note: Firecrawl may have served the US price; Canva shows local currency by region, so AUD pricing for Australians is unclear. Do not quote the 50% promo.

facts.claim: Paperless Post save the dates can be customised and shared by email, text or link; it says opens can be tracked; text (SMS) delivery is for US phone numbers only.
facts.quote: Set the tone for a seaside celebration with beach-themed save the dates. Customize and share via email, text, or link. ... Send all of our invitations and cards via text, Shareable Link, and email, too. \* SMS delivery available for US phone numbers only. [meta description:] Browse free and paid beach and tropical save the date card templates. Customize designs. Send ecards via email, text, or link. Track opens.
facts.publisher: Paperless Post (official save the dates category page)
facts.use_note: For Australian guests: SMS is US numbers only, so use email or the Shareable Link (which can be pasted into any message app). 'Track opens' appears in the page meta description, not body copy.

facts.claim: Greenvelope digital wedding save the dates: animated envelope with liner, stamp and music; send by email, text or sharable link; no guest account; address collection inside the save the date; add your wedding website link; tracks opens and responses in real time; upload your own design; daily open-rate summaries.
facts.quote: Send by email, text, or sharable link, ad-free with no guest account required and a flat one-time price by guest count. ... Address Collection Collect guest mailing addresses directly through your save the date for sending paper invitations or thank you notes. ... Your Own Design Have a more specific vision? Upload your own design and still take advantage of Greenvelope's delivery and tracking. ... Add your wedding website link, then send by email, text message, or sharable link. Greenvelope tracks opens and responses in real time and can collect mailing addresses for the invitations that follow. ... Greenvelope pairs with any wedding website builder.
facts.publisher: Greenvelope (official wedding save the dates page)
facts.use_note: Ignore the page's own '4.9 stars Trustpilot' and 'best way' marketing claims; do not repeat them.

facts.claim: Greenvelope single mailing prices (USD, as listed): up to 20 people $19; up to 100 $99; up to 150 not a tier (up to 160 $159); up to 200 $199; up to 250 $249. Unlimited mailings for a year: up to 150 people per mailing $225/year; up to 250 $375/year. Each person on the list counts as one (a family of four counts as four).
facts.quote: One mailing $19 one time Up to 20 people ... Up to 100 People$99 ... Up to 160 People$159 ... Up to 200 People$199 ... Up to 250 People$249 ... Up to 150 People / Mailing$225 / Year ... Up to 250 People / Mailing$375 / Year ... Each person (with or without email) added to the mailing list counts as (1) person. For example, "The Smith Family" of John, Jill, Tim, and Lauren would count as (4) people.
facts.publisher: Greenvelope (official wedding save the dates page)
facts.use_note: $ unlabelled; US company, treat as USD and say so. Prices as read 26 Nov 2026.

facts.claim: Greenvelope text delivery: every paid account includes a maximum of 500 text messages; SMS is 'in supported countries'; also WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger or sharable link.
facts.quote: Every paid Greenvelope account includes a maximum of 500 text messages. ... In addition to email, you can send your Greenvelope invitations and cards via SMS text message (in supported countries), WhatsApp, Facebook messenger, or a sharable link.
facts.publisher: Greenvelope (official wedding save the dates page)
facts.use_note: Whether Australian mobile numbers are a supported SMS country is unclear from this page.

facts.claim: Greenvelope's own timing line: most couples send save the dates 6 to 8 months before, or 8 to 12 months for a destination wedding.
facts.quote: Most couples send wedding save the dates 6 to 8 months before the wedding, or 8 to 12 months for a destination wedding so guests can book travel.
facts.publisher: Greenvelope (official wedding save the dates page)
facts.use_note: Platform opinion, not ours. Use our own timing (see WW facts) as the article's guidance; this is a cross-check only.
